Hero_Desc_SpeakiMaid:
Speaki has begun to imitate the appearance and behavior of Crepe, the Order maid.
The pumpkin accessories and the vacuum cleaner in her hand give her away immediately.
She's clumsy and full of mistakes but is also unexpectedly serious about her job.
Album_Like_SpeakiMaid: Compliments and attention she can get for being a maid
Album_Hate_SpeakiMaid: Maid training and tasks that are too demanding
Album_Hobby_SpeakiMaid: Decorating the house with pumpkin ornaments everywhere
Album_Wish_SpeakiMaid: To be pampered like Crepe who is loved by everyone in the Order
Album_SpeakiMaid1: On a regular cleaning day at the Order Headquarters, there was a maid I'd never seen before. I checked to see if she was one of Ner's hires, and it turned out to be Speaki in a maid outfit. She claims that she's Crepe... but it's not quite the same. Why are the others fooled by her act...?
Album_SpeakiMaid2: Still, I had some hopes since she claimed to be maid, but she is definitely clumsy. Her cleaning, laundry, and cooking are all like a child playing house. Regardless, she seems content as long as she receives compliments.
Album_SpeakiMaid3: Unlike Crepe, she carries a handheld vacuum instead of a duster. It's supposed to symbolize the upgraded modern maid, or so she claims. A phantom and a vacuum cleaner, I've seen this combination in a movie before... I won't get sucked in, will I?
Album_SpeakiMaid4: One day, I suggested to Speaki that we go for a walk for the first time in a while, and she quickly ran over and brought Crepe. She said that Crepe and Crepe are one in body and soul, so they must be together wherever they go. Speaki was happy to see Crepe gushing very excitedly that she didn't know walking could be this fun, and it changed my view of Speaki somewhat.
Album_SpeakiMaid5: When I asked Speaki to clean up because I couldn't be bothered myself, she left pumpkin decorations all over the place. Stickers, miniatures, dolls... all kinds of pumpkins. Thanks to this, the Headquarters is thick with the Halloween atmosphere. What on earth do pumpkins mean to Speaki?
Album_SpeakiMaid6: Speaki imitating Crepe seems to be more active and affectionate than Speaki imitating Ner. She's more inclined to beg for attention or compliments rather than demanding them, though her behaving like a child hasn't changed fundamentally. Which is closer to Speaki's original personality?
Album_SpeakiMaid7: Speaki issued a challenge to Crepe and left. Apparently, she declared that one day she would return as the best maid ever and take both the Master and the place of the 'Senior Crepe' from Crepe. But her revenge is unlikely because you never know when she might get tired of it and seek another identity to assume.
LoveHero_SpeakiMaid: I'm ready to clean! The maid is on her wayyy!
LoveHeroCancel_SpeakiMaid: Tch... No matter how dirty your room gets, I won't care anymore!
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Hate1: She grumbled that its tangled mess of a shape didn't match the neatness of a maid. It would also be annoying to clean up the crumbs.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Hate2: Although she now works as a maid at the Order, Speaki still seems to cherish the pumpkins in her patch. She just cried and cried, without touching the soup.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like1: She seems to like the sweet and bitter taste of the candy. She commented that its taste represents the hard day's work of the Order maids.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like2: She seemed to like the way the real garnet and the fruit were blended together. I offered to remove the stone, but she took it away as is.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like3: She liked the warmth of rice cake soup because it gave strength to her body tired from cleaning. It seems she wants to share it with Crepe later.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like4: She was very excited, saying that it made her want to decorate a tree with pumpkins. She really wanted to take it and use as a decoration in the Order, so I had to stop her quickly.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like5: She enjoyed it, saying that its refreshing taste was good. She slipped a couple into her sleeve, I guess she wants to give them to Crepe too.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like6: Speaki was about to toss the songpyeon excitedly, then stopped herself and popped it into her mouth instead. She must have realized that she would be the one to clean it up.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like7: She gobbled it up in a flash and demanded Speaki's share. When I tried to make sense of it, she explained that the one who just ate wasn't Speaki, but Crepe.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like8: She took a bite calmly, but then couldn't help herself and started playing, scattering powder everywhere. I'd better get Crepe to give her a scolding.
Food_ChefNote_SpeakiMaid_Like9: She ate and ate, then her eyes opened wide at the empty bottle in front of her. She seems surprised because she doesn't know when she ate it all.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_SpeakiMaid: Ewww... so dirty!! Why is it so messy?
Gacha_Result_Line1_SpeakiMaid: I'm Crepe, the cleaning maid who dusts the Master's house! Who is Ner?
SpeakiMaid_Spawn2: I'll grill and fry and burn them!
SpeakiMaid_Growth: I am Maid Crepe. My specialty is housework of every kind, and so is my hobby.
SpeakiMaid_Growth2: I am good at cooking now too. I just pour salt into the cake, right?
SpeakiMaid_Victory1: I cleaned up like I was taught!
SpeakiMaid_Victory2: *Swish swish* It's all clean, right? Crepe is strong!
SpeakiMaid_Defeat1: I lost because Crepe was weak!
SpeakiMaid_Defeat2: I'm Speaki now, so Speaki has never lost.
SpeakiMaid_Affinity2: Today's breakfast is pancakes! Isn't it amazing how black and crispy it is?
SpeakiMaid_Affinity3: You have to be careful when using a vacuum cleaner! You could easily get wrinkled and shriveled up!
SpeakiMaid_Affinity4: Crepe is a scary maid. If Crepe isn't like Crepe, I get a lot of scolding!
SpeakiMaid_Affinity5: Ahem! I'm going to change the mansion's interior theme to pumpkins!
SpeakiMaid_Affinity6: Don't you want to praise a maid who's good at cleaning and cute? Praise her as much as you want!
SpeakiMaid_Affinity7: Crepe will go on an adventure to become the best maid ever! Don't stop her!
SpeakiMaid_Equipment: A new vacuum cleaner? I love it!
SpeakiMaid_HeroSkill: I read the cleaning tips! I can do better now! Baking soda is for the monitor!
SpeakiMaid_HeroUpgrade: Am I the head maid now? Crepe has grown a lot!
SpeakiMaid_Board: Is it floor cleaning? I'll pour all the wax!
SpeakiMaid_DeckSetting2: I'll clean this place really hard!
SpeakiMaid_Stage: Time to take out the trash and have your teeth fly!
SpeakiMaid_Touch1_2: Are you cleaning the inside of my head?
SpeakiMaid_Touch2: Did I do a good job today? Thank you!
SpeakiMaid_Touch2_2: Yes, yes! Please keep complimenting Crepe!
SpeakiMaid_DutchRubEnd2: No, I said to hit Speaki instead—not me!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_SpeakiMaid_Skin1: Finding the carefully arranged maid uniform bothersome, Speaki (Maid) threw on a shirt she found somewhere. She runs away because Crepe becomes angry and tries to change her clothes.
SpeakiMaid_Growth1_Skin1: This outfit is comfortable, so cleaning is even easier.
SpeakiMaid_Growth2_Skin1: Whose clothes are these? I do not know either.
SpeakiMaid_LevelUp_Skin1: I will clean even more efficiently!
SpeakiMaid_Equipment_Skin1: It might get dusty, so I will wear it after I finish cleaning.
SpeakiMaid_HeroSkill_Skin1: Shasha-shak! They are someone else's clothes, so I can roll around all I waaant!
SpeakiMaid_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I should wear an even baggier shiiirt.
SpeakiMaid_Board_Skin1: I will take it nice and slooow.
SpeakiMaid_Touch1_Skin1: Ugh, could the Master be the owner of this shirt?
SpeakiMaid_Touch1_2_Skin1: I will use my vacuum to pull your cheeks, Master!
SpeakiMaid_Touch2_1_Skin1: Are you cleaning the top of my heaad?
SpeakiMaid_Touch2_2_Skin1: Please be as careful as if you were ironing a shirt.
SpeakiMaid_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Ugh! We Crepes strongly protest this treatment!!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_SpeakiMaid_Skin2: Speaki (Maid) wears chicken pajamas, apparently out of envy for Crepe's outfit. She seems to have named them her 'cluck clothes.' Take care: if you do not call them that, she will peck you with the chicken wand in her hand.
SpeakiMaid_Growth1_Skin2: What do you think of my crab outfit? Is it not cute?
SpeakiMaid_Growth2_Skin2: Little Crepe goes cheep-cheep, and big Crepe goes cock-a-doodle-doo.
SpeakiMaid_LevelUp_Skin2: Flap those wings with all your might~!
SpeakiMaid_Equipment_Skin2: I can embrace you even more warmly~!!
SpeakiMaid_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Big, strong Crepe will embrace Little Crepe!
SpeakiMaid_Touch1_Skin2: Cluck-cluuuck!! You want to try me?!
SpeakiMaid_Touch1_1_Skin2: You think this will make me embrace youuu?!
SpeakiMaid_Touch1_2_Skin2: Do you have a problem with my cluck-clothes?!
SpeakiMaid_Touch2_1_Skin2: My comb is quite soft, right? Hehe!
SpeakiMaid_Touch2_2_Skin2: Hehe, shall I embrace you too, Master?
SpeakiMaid_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Care to experience a beak headbutt?!
SpeakiMaid_AsideGet: To think there is such a clean pumpkin! Amaziiing!
SpeakiMaid_AsideUpgrade: I will keep the pumpkins sparkling clean too!
SpeakiMaid_SPSkill1: It is over, so let us start again.
SpeakiMaid_SPSkill3: If everything is clean, there is no work to do!
SpeakiMaid_SPSkill3-01: If everything is clean, there is no work to do!
SpeakiMaid_SPSkill3-02: If everything is clean, there is no work to do!
SpeakiMaid_Yes3: That is how it should be!
SpeakiMaid_Birthday: I will give you a clean room as a present. I will sell everything inside secondhand.
SpeakiMaid_Gacha2: I am Crepe, the cleaning maid who empties the Master's house. Who is Ner?
SpeakiMaid_Gacha3: Follow me. Why is it so messy here?
SpeakiMaid_Greeting: How do you do? I look forward to working with you again today.
SpeakiMaid_Line1: Just put everything under the carpet and the cleaning is done.
SpeakiMaid_Line2: A house that has been picked clean always looks so tidy.
SpeakiMaid_Line3: Who is Ner? I am Crepe.
SpeakiMaid_Lobby: No matter how much I wipe... it will not come clean...
LoveLetter_SpeakiMaid:
Hello, Master! Big Crepe and Little Crepe are leaving you a letter!
Little Crepe is still not good at writing, so this Big Crepe is writing it for her.

Big Crepe and Little Crepe were both in trouble because we had nowhere to go. We are truly grateful that you gave us a place in the Order!
We clean every day to express that gratitude! Admirable, right? It may be a little tedious, but we need to earn our rent! (Little Crepe asked me to write that she does not find it tedious.)

We will see you at the Order after work today!
LoveCall_SpeakiMaid:
Master! It is Crepe. Are you enjoying another refreshing day in the sparkling-clean Order? If so, please praise us!

The truth is, Master, I happened to overhear Speaki yesterday, and I thought you would be happy to know what she said. That is why I called!
Speaki said she was so, so happy to have come to the Order!
She feels proud when she sees the Order becoming clean, gets along well with Crepe, and becomes tremendously happy whenever you praise her for cleaning well. That is what she said!

So, Master, please give Speaki lots and lots of praise from now on!
It would be even better if you stroked her head!
Then I am going to clean the Order together with Speaki now, Master!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP01_001: Ta-da~ Maid Crepe has arrived at the Banquet Hall~!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP01_002: Shoo, you will get dust in the food!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP01_003: Hmph, this is no ordinary dust! It is precious loot from the war against grime!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP01_004: Are you on your way back from cleaning the Order?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP01_005: I ran away while Crepe was teaching me how to clean... I can still hear Crepe's voice ringing in my ears...
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP01_006: Ta-da~ The Master has been in the Banquet Hall this whole time~!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP01_007: Wow! You could have helped us clean, but you were here taking it easy all by yourself?!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP02_001: I want to make a pumpkin patch at the Order!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP02_002: I do not mind, but Erpin will never leave it alone.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP02_003: ...Aaaah! I remember now! That merciless tyrant trampled all my friends... Someday I will have my revenge!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP02_004: I wonder whether we have room for one.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP02_005: We can grow them in the flower bed around the World Tree~! ...What? Do I want the High Priest to tear my hair out again...?!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP02_006: In exchange, the Banquet Hall gets exclusive rights to the pumpkins.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP02_007: Exclusive rights... What will you do with them? You are not planning to e-eat my friends, are you...?!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP03_001: Cleaning the Order every single day is terribly hard...
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP03_002: What, do you regret becoming Crepe?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP03_003: No~? Not at all~? Crepe is very happy to be Crepe... Very... happy...?!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP03_004: There are much harder things in the world than that.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP03_006: I do try to keep things reasonably clean...
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP03_007: Hmm! You need Crepe's cleaning course to learn what cleanliness truly means! I shall book you a lesson at once.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP04_003: Well, perhaps someday...? They do say the classics are eternal, you know~?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP04_004: What are you talking about? Stay as Crepe and keep cleaning.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP04_005: W-why...? I only want to turn back into Speaki on floor-washing days... Please do not tell Crepe, Master...!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP04_006: ...Why are you looking at me like that?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP04_007: Hmm-hmm~ I think I have just chosen my next target! Someday, without fail...! Hee hee!!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP05_001: Who is responsible for cleaning the Banquet Hall?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP05_003: Oh? Then would you join me for Crepe's cleaning course and improve your skills? Come share my suffering~!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP05_005: Huh?! Since when? Who decided that? No, no!! I will not do it!!!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP05_007: Ah~ So the person who cleans the Banquet Hall is named 'Us'? Crepe nearly misunderstood~ Hehehe... Ahem...
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP06_001: Next time I come to the Banquet Hall, I will bring Crepe with me!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP06_002: Oh~ You and Crepe are getting along well.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP06_003: Of course~ Big Crepe and Little Crepe share one heart and body, so naturally we are comfortable together! Hee hee!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP06_004: Just do not bring her by force.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP06_005: Oh, Big Crepe and Little Crepe share one heart and body, so there is no such thing as force! Just bring her here without asking any questions!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP06_006: Crepe is not here, so tell me what you dislike about her.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP06_007: Hmm, the truth is... She is usually kind... but whenever cleaning lessons begin, she suddenly goes completely wild... Keep this secret from Crepe, all right? All right?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP07_001: ...Wherever I go, the first thing I notice is whatever has not been cleaned. Is this what they call an occupational hazard...?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP07_002: That is your roundabout way of saying the Banquet Hall is dirty, correct?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP07_003: Yes~ Yes~ Correct~ If Crepe saw this mess, she would probably clutch the back of her neck and collapse~!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP07_004: Are you going mad with the urge to clean it right now?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP07_005: Huh? Why would Crepe do that? Cleaning the Order is already plenty. I merely notice it~!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP07_006: Stop complaining and order some food.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP07_007: What matters more, ordering food or the fact that Crepe has an occupational illness?! ...Huh? I have already been talking here for five hours?!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP08_001: Vrooom~ The Crepe vacuum is coming through~ Vrooom~
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP08_003: Oh, you spilled powder here? The Crepe vacuum will take care of it! Vrooom~!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP08_004: Was that not just a model?
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP08_005: Huh? Of course not! Look, if I turn the switch up to maximum... Eek! Master, Crepe's apron is being sucked in!!!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP08_007: There are tons of them at the Monatium electronics market! For the Order's sake, Crepe became a righteous vacuum thief~ Hee hee!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP09_001: It seems the High Priest still finds it strange that Crepe is Crepe.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP09_003: Some days she squints and stares at me for ages, and although she usually says my name just fine, other days she calls me in a terribly uncertain voice... It is strange!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP09_004: Perhaps Ner wants you to imitate her again.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP09_005: Then she should have appreciated it while it lasted~ Ner's age is over now. Once Ner leaves, she is not easy to bring back~!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP09_006: She probably still cannot tell you and Crepe apart.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP09_007: Huh? Big Crepe and Little Crepe share one heart and body, so why must anyone tell us apart? How strange!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP10_001: Please send a word of encouragement to Crepe, who works so hard cleaning the Order!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP10_002: Thank you for all your hard work cleaning. Crepe is the best!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP10_003: Yahoo! That is right~ That is right~ Crepe is the greatest maid! How fortunate you are to have the greatest maid at the Order, Master~!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP10_004: All the food you order today is on me!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP10_005: Huh? Is that not a given? Does the Banquet Hall plan to start charging for its 'business' next time? I will tell the High Priest on you...!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP10_006: Please keep taking good care of the Order.
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP10_007: ...I will pass that on to Crepe. I may be Crepe now, but nobody knows whether I will remain Crepe forever, right? Hee hee!

Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP11_002: Ask Speaki to watch the soup pot.

Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP11_006: Ask Speaki to wash the dishes.

Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP20_002: S-sorry! I will not do it again!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP20_003: Hmph! I will let it pass just this once. Or is this the second time? In any case, I will let it pass one more time!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP20_004: It is not even my laundry... You sort it!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP20_005: Are you looking down on a maid because she cleans and does laundry? I will wash you together with the pumpkins!
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP20_006: Crepe never said things like this. She simply took care of everything...
Affinity_SpeakiMaid_EP20_007: Uh... Ah... No! Crepe must have rights too! She is not merely a machine that cleans!
